name.ja: マッドレア・ディスターブ

requirement.en: When your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s) during their turn, except a Maximum Monster, send 1 monster from your hand or field to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Destroy 1 monster on your opponent's field. Until the end of your next turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters, and you can only attack with DARK Attribute monsters with 1100 original DEF.
